views.name: RCA latero-lateral (right lateral)
views.notes: No change in angle (question b). It is a real named view: Rigatelli 2022 Fig 6 I-J prints RAO 80 / CAU 10 'latero-lateral', and the drawing puts the spine on the left (RAO side). The audit finding that it should be LAO 90 is not supported by any source. Di Mario's RCA lateral does not name a side. Remove the current text's claims about 'anterior origin ostium' and 'best evaluation of ... PDA/PL'; Di Mario rates the lateral '-' for PDA and crux, and the other claims could not be checked (Rigatelli text unread).
views.purpose: May be the best view of the mid right coronary, and is sometimes used as the working view for occlusions or stent placement in that segment. Not part of the routine set.
